# claude-statusline

> A fast, dependency-light Rust status line for Claude Code. It renders the JSON Claude Code streams on stdin as a single powerline row — model, git branch, color-coded context-window usage, live cost (session, per-hour burn rate, and today's total across all sessions), chronis task, rate limits, and lines changed — and never blanks, hangs, or panics.

claude-statusline is installed with `cargo install --git https://github.com/decebal/claude-statusline` and wired via the `statusLine.command` key in `~/.claude/settings.json`. It is MIT-licensed and depends only on `serde` and `serde_json`.

## Key facts
- Language: Rust, single stripped binary (~525 KB), two dependencies (serde, serde_json). Ships three optional companion hook binaries: `claude-health-hook`, `claude-health-report`, `claude-mcp-probe`.
- Design principle throughout: a segment draws only when it has something to say. A number that is identical on every render (total skill count, "all servers connected") is treated as noise and omitted, so the presence of a segment is itself the signal.
- Segments: model, caveman mode (optional), repo/dir, git branch (read from `.git/HEAD`, no subprocess), project skills (optional), context % (green <50 / yellow 50–80 / bold-red >80 or `exceeds_200k_tokens`), cost cluster (`session · ~$/hr burn · today $total`), MCP trouble (optional), chronis task, rate limits (5h/7d, Pro/Max), lines ±.
- Project skills: counts subdirs of `$cwd/.claude/skills/` holding a `SKILL.md` (one `read_dir`, no cache). The GLOBAL skill count is never rendered — it is identical on every repo and every render, so it informs nothing. When cwd is `$HOME`, `$cwd/.claude/skills` IS the global dir and the segment draws nothing rather than mislabelling global skills as project skills. Hide with `CLAUDE_STATUSLINE_NO_SKILLS=1`.
- MCP trouble: renders ONLY servers that failed (red) or need auth (yellow) — a healthy fleet costs zero columns, and it is the one optional segment never dropped on a narrow terminal. The status line cannot check this itself (`claude mcp list` takes SECONDS), so the bundled `claude-mcp-probe` binary runs on SessionStart and caches `{name: status}` to `$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/statusline-cache/mcp.json`. Because Claude Code blocks startup on hooks, the hook only `stat`s the cache (returns instantly if younger than `CLAUDE_STATUSLINE_MCP_REFRESH`, default 4h) and otherwise re-launches itself DETACHED — hook returns in ~10 ms. `--foreground` probes synchronously. SECURITY: the probe records server name + status only, never the argv, because `claude mcp list` echoes stdio servers' full command lines including API keys; two tests assert no part of a sample argv survives. Unrecognized status wording is recorded `unknown` and NOT counted as trouble; a run that parses to nothing leaves the old cache rather than writing `{}` (which would read as "all healthy").
- Caveman: renders the [caveman](https://github.com/JuliusBrussee/caveman) plugin's badge natively — level + tokens saved — from `$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/.caveman-active` and `.caveman-statusline-suffix`, so its `caveman-statusline.sh` is not needed. Absent files = no segment; `off` = no segment; savings only after `/caveman-stats` has run. Flag files are treated as hostile: symlinks refused, 64-byte read cap, level whitelisted, savings must parse as a whole token count.
- Cost: session cost and burn rate come from stdin; today's total is computed from token `usage` in `~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl` × a per-model price table because transcripts store `costUSD: null`. Cache rates follow Anthropic ratios (read 0.10×, 5-min write 1.25×, 1-hour write 2.0×). Override prices via `~/.claude/statusline-pricing.json`.
- Agent health green bars are strict: rules and truth need >=4.75, task >=4.50, stability >=4.75; truth <4.50 or rules <4.25 hard-gates to Restart. So `T4.7` renders DEGRADED (yellow), not healthy — a common doc/example mistake.
- Agent health: an optional first segment (rules/truth/task/stability + green-yellow-red verdict) read from `~/.claude/agent-health/<session_id>.json`. Two bundled hooks fill it — `claude-health-hook` (PostToolUse + PostToolUseFailure) writes the observable stability + drift; `claude-health-report` (Stop) grades rules/truth/task with a cheap judge model (~$0.02/turn, detached so it never blocks the turn, guarded against recursing into itself). Unscored dimensions render `–`; nothing is ever invented.
- Guarantees: always prints one non-empty line and exits 0 on any input (verified across ~40 malformed/hostile inputs); `cn` lookup bounded to ≤800 ms and cached per-cwd; daily scan cached 60 s; warm renders single-digit milliseconds.
- Responsive width: reads `COLUMNS` (Claude Code v2.1.153+) and degrades gracefully on narrow/split screens — drops project skills → caveman → lines± → rate limit → cost burn/today extras → repo → git branch → task, always keeping the essentials (model, context %, cost) plus MCP trouble. Unset COLUMNS = full render.
- Config env vars: `CLAUDE_STATUSLINE_ASCII=1` (ASCII fallback, no Nerd Font), `CLAUDE_STATUSLINE_NO_DAILY=1` (skip transcript scan), `CLAUDE_STATUSLINE_NO_CAVEMAN=1` (hide the caveman badge), `CLAUDE_STATUSLINE_NO_SKILLS=1` (hide the project-skills count), `CLAUDE_STATUSLINE_NO_MCP=1` (hide MCP trouble; also makes the probe a no-op), `CLAUDE_STATUSLINE_MCP_CACHE` (probe cache path), `CLAUDE_STATUSLINE_MCP_REFRESH` (probe staleness bound, default 14400s), `CLAUDE_STATUSLINE_CLAUDE_BIN` (path to `claude`, for the probe), `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` (where the caveman flags and probe cache live, default `~/.claude`), `CLAUDE_STATUSLINE_CN_TTL` (task cache TTL, default 8s), `CLAUDE_STATUSLINE_CN_BIN` (path to cn).

## Docs
- [README](README.md): install, configuration, cost model, comparison, and FAQ.
- [docs/statusline.svg](docs/statusline.svg): the preview image — the same line in three states (everyday / trouble / half-width pane). Every value in it is verbatim binary output, rendered from fixtures with isolated `HOME` and `TMPDIR`; the glyphs are GitHub-safe lookalikes for the real Nerd-Font ones.
- [docs/agent-health.md](docs/agent-health.md): health schema, rubric, thresholds, hook wiring.
- [LICENSE](LICENSE): MIT.

## FAQ
- Does it need a Nerd Font? No — `CLAUDE_STATUSLINE_ASCII=1` renders plain-text labels with colors.
- How is today's cost computed? Sum of today's transcript token usage × per-model pricing (transcripts store no per-line cost).
- Will it slow Claude Code down? No — single-digit-ms warm renders, the one external call (`cn`) is capped and cached, no git/jq subprocess on the hot path.
- Does it require chronis? No — the task segment is omitted if `cn` or a task is absent.
- What on malformed input? It still prints a valid line and exits 0; only the affected segment is omitted.
